meta.name: eol-readiness-advisor
meta.description: Run a go/no-go assessment for retiring a product or feature, then right-size the effort. Use when someone says "we should probably kill this" and nobody has made the call.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估产品是否该退役,并规划后续投入
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队对是否下架某个产品或功能迟迟做不了决定。
copy.tagline_en: Decide whether to retire a product and right-size the wind-down effort.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team can't decide whether to kill a product or feature.

howto.what: 运行退役评估：先问清要退役的产品和原因，再了解影响范围、强度、用户去向，最后给出裁决（Go/Hold等）、强度级别、需检查的义务和下一步。
howto.when: 当你说“也许该砍掉这个”但没人做决定时触发；也可主动请求评估某个产品或功能的退役。

say.text: 评估一下是否退役旧报表模块——使用率降60%，支持成本在涨。
say.note: Claude会问4个问题后给出裁决。

say.text: 对NFA-200控制器产品线做EOL评估，120个安装，有渠道伙伴。
say.note: 这些信息算已有答案，部分问题会跳过。

say.text: 领导说该砍这个功能但没人拍板，帮我做个Go/No-Go评估。

howto.what_en: Runs a go/no-go assessment for retiring a product/feature: asks about the item and trigger, blast radius, intensity, and customer landing, then outputs a verdict, intensity level, obligations, and next steps.
howto.when_en: Triggers when someone says 'we should probably kill this' and nobody has made the call. Also when you explicitly ask for an EOL readiness assessment of a product or feature.

say_en.text: Retire our legacy reporting module? Usage down 60%, support costs rising.
say_en.note: Claude asks the four questions and delivers a verdict.

say_en.text: Run EOL readiness on NFA-200 controller line — 120 installs, channel partners.
say_en.note: Provided context counts; some questions may be skipped.

say_en.text: Leadership says kill this feature but no one decides. Assess it.
